title: Matched Filter
text: Matched filter, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Spectrum window} sets Window for spectrum weighting; {Source of coefficients} sets the source of matched filter coefficients, {Coefficients} sets the matched filter coefficients, {Spectrum window range (Hz)} sets the spectrum window coverage region, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of the output, {Sidelobe attenuation level} sets the window sidelobe attenuation level, {Kaiser shape parameter}, {Number of constant level sidelobes} sets the number of nearly constant sidelobes in Taylor, {Enable SNR gain output} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
